phases.title: Package Header Parsing & VFS Architecture
phases.notes: (Exists) PackageFile header/entry/block parsing, PackageCatalog, tag-hash lookup. Solforge: PackageCatalog.Index.cs metadata index (package-index-v1/<root hash>.bin beside the data cache; headers for every patch file, tables for current packages, name rows; keyed by file name + length + write time, any change rebuilds; disabled cache = no index), PackageFile I/O split (ReadTables/LoadTables(bytes)), CollectNameRows/ApplyNameRows split, PackageCatalog.Search.cs (FindByClass, FindByType, GetPackageGroup, FindPackagesInGroup, GetPackageEntries). Check: tests/SunriseStudio.Packages.Tests (scratch packages always; --game-root times the warm open: 400+ files must open from the index under 1 s, skipped without -Game). Memory mapping not needed; the index is the profiled answer

phases.title: Block Decompression & Oodle Integration
phases.notes: (Exists) OodleDecoder (oo2core_3_win64.dll from the install, thread-safe pooled buffers), PackageKeys AES-128-GCM, raw blocks; no zlib path. Solforge: PackageCatalog.Parallel.cs (MaximumParallelDecodes bound, default min(cores, 8); ReadOriginalParallel warms a tag's blocks through the serial CopyBlock path on a bounded Parallel.For, capped at half the LRU, then assembles serially; ReadOriginalAsync; ReadOriginalAll bounded multi-tag reads in input order). Check: Packages.Tests compares serial vs parallel/all/async/bound-1 on PackageWriter scratch packages (a 1.6 MB 7-block tag); --game-root compares the 32 largest installed multi-block (Oodle + AES) tags on cold catalogs and prints both timings. Synthetic Oodle round trip not possible (no compressor binding); installed blocks cover the Oodle path

phases.title: Tag Deserialization & Structural Memory Mapping
phases.notes: (Exists) typed deserializers: Strings = Packages/LocalizedStrings.cs, Entity Templates = ComponentIndex.EntityConfigs + ComponentRoles.ReadConfig (EntityComponents.cs), Sound Banks = Audio/AudioCatalog.ReadBank + WwiseSoundBank.Nodes; Formats.TagReader. Solforge: Packages/TagHeaders.cs (Compose/TryDecompose per §5.4, ParseEntryTable/ParseEntryRecord/WriteEntryRecord per §5.2; PackageFile.LoadTables now parses through it), PackageCatalog.TryLocate, Packages/TagDependencyGraph.cs (TryAdd/Add reject cycle and self edges, RejectedEdges, Reaches, Closure, TopologicalOrder, bounded Build walk). Check: Packages.Tests (hash mapping, record round trip, 10,000-header parse best of 5 under 100 ms, DAG cycle rejection/order/Build); --game-root maps every installed hash and builds a native-dependency DAG from 200 entity templates. Memory mapping still not needed (Phase 05 index)

phases.title: Package Entry Table Modification & Block Writing
phases.notes: (Exists) PackageWriter.WritePatch/WriteNew/WriteReplacement (block placement, 8192-entry/16384-block/0x0100-0x0CFF limits), StringBankWriter. Solforge: Packages/PackageDelta.cs: PackageBlockAllocator (opens the source read-only, Replace/Append, places edits with PackageWriter.Place after the source's last block, writes an SFPD v1 project delta atomically: header bound to source length + metadata SHA-1, 32-byte redirect rows with PackageEntryOverride Replaced/Appended flags and old/new block info, 48-byte block records with target patch, raw flags, SHA-1), CheckLimits/CheckNewPackageId; PackageDelta (Read validates block SHA-1s, Matches, ReadEntry, BuildEntryTable = next patch entry table). PackageWriter.Place is now internal. Check: Packages.Tests mock replace + append into a scratch project delta, verifies redirects/blocks/bytes/table, source SHA-256/length/write time unchanged, limits, refusal to write over the source, damaged-block detection

phases.title: Mesh Decoding & Vertex Buffers
phases.notes: (Exists) preview decoders give Position and UV0 only and regenerate normals (Scene/StaticMeshDecoder.cs, EntityMeshDecoder.cs, TerrainDecoder.cs); NORMAL/TANGENT are CPU-decoded only for the declaration-123 static profile when its shader consumes them (Formats/NativeMeshBasis.cs); UV1 detail UVs only for entity parts on export, from half2/float2 TEXCOORD2 streams (Interchange/AssetBundle.DetailUvs.cs); the game-shader path uploads raw streams with NativeMeshReader.cs input layouts incl. terrain half2 UVs; D3D index/vertex buffers (Rendering/RenderTypes.cs GpuMesh) and per-part multi-submesh draws (Viewport/NativeSceneRenderer.cs). Solforge: CPU decoder for half floats, SNORM/UNORM/SINT streams, SNORM16 normal+tangent frames (handedness in tangent W), quaternion tangent frames and octahedral normals (Scene/VertexAttributeDecoding.cs). Not wired: referenced only by ViewportPipeline.Tests GeometryChecks; export decodes half/SNORM itself (NativeMeshReader.ApplyNativeTexcoords, Interchange/BundleMeshCodec, Formats/NativeMeshBasis.cs) and picking uses the preview MeshData. Done needs NativeMeshBasis/NativeMeshReader routed through it. Checks: ViewportPipeline.Tests GeometryChecks. Unbuilt: stays partial until the main session's build and verify.ps1 pass and the manual checks are done.

phases.title: Shader & Material Pipeline
phases.notes: (Exists) game-material shading instead of a stand-in PBR shader: GameMaterialReader + NativeMaterialPipeline execute the original Tiger pixel shaders (Rendering/NativeRendering.cs, NativeDeferredShading.cs); BC1-BC5 CPU decode (Formats/TexturePixels.cs), BC7 via BCnEncoder.Net BcDecoder (Interchange/BundleTextureCodec.cs), all BCn on the GPU (Rendering/TextureUploads.cs incl. cube textures); authored cubemap probes and ambient diffuse in the game-shader path (Rendering/NativeCubemapLighting.cs, NativeAmbientLighting.cs). Solforge: CPU cubemap -> SH9 irradiance projection, box probe weights/nesting and box-projected (parallax) lookups (Rendering/ProbeLighting.cs) as standalone CPU math: nothing outside ViewportPipeline.Tests ProbeChecks references it, so the geometry preview, export and fallback MeshShader do not use it. The cubemap-probe and ambient-diffuse requirement is met by the game-shader path above. Checks: ViewportPipeline.Tests ProbeChecks. phases.title: Checker Phase: Viewport & Geometry Pipeline Audit
phases.notes: Audit check written: tests/SunriseStudio.ViewportPipeline.Tests/AuditChecks.cs, run by verify.ps1 -Game (prints 'skipped:' and passes without --game or a hardware adapter; WARP never benchmarks). It checks 1,002,528 triangles at 1920x1080 >= 60 FPS (120 frames, one sync), map 80EDC19B (Leviathan) in the viewport, and 50 load/unload cycles with < 96 MiB private-byte growth and < 64 MiB DXGI local video-memory growth after warm-up (video skipped when the adapter has no IDXGIAdapter3). The destination and every cycle re-read the map with WorldLoader and render it with game shaders (PrepareNativeScene + SetNativeScene, asserting UseGameShaders and no NativeError), then Clear. Limits: the million-triangle benchmark is a synthetic flat grid on the geometry path, not a game-shader map; the private-byte bound is about 2 MiB a cycle; one map only; 50 full map loads make the run long. Manual steps: (1) run .\verify.ps1 -Game <install> on a machine with a GPU and record the 'audit' lines; (2) look up the Trostland church and Tower plaza map tags and add them to AuditChecks.DestinationMap (or a list) - not known here; (3) open both destinations in Solforge, check 60+ FPS in the View > Statistics overlay

Added: DependencyCrawler.cs (Projects) walks changed + added tags one level (native refs + structured tag words), DependencyManifest writes build/dependencies.json with MissingReference / InvalidNativeReference / MissingProjectFile issues; PackageIdAllocator.cs allocates 0x0100-0x0CFF skipping installed + project ids. Checks: ProjectSystem.Tests DependencyChecks. Crawl now walks the build tag set (raw changes, compiled object edits, config bindings, added, generated) on the bytes the build writes; native-link issues carry the missing child kind (Texture, Audio, Buffer, ...), bare structured words stay Unknown; script references are not classified. Left: Studio Build does not call DependencyCrawler.Crawl(...).Write(...), PackageIdAllocator.For is unused by new-asset id flows (ObjectEditContext.Generated.cs, CollisionImport.cs, Authoring/Creation keep their own scans); no check plants a missing reference through an object edit (needs a registered ObjectEdit compiler in ProjectSystem.Tests)
